rng: xorshift32 shifts 13,17,5; one stream seeded once; 16 draws per exponent in ascending exponent order; mantissa = state & 0x7FFFFF
truncation_rule: not exercised while pre_cap_count <= cap; a binding cap would keep the first cap entries of the canonical order (primary ascending by bit pattern, then specials in manifest order)
order: primary ascending by bit pattern, then specials not already present, in SPECIALS order
predicates_declared: none; special-value predicates and the acceptance verdict are frozen by a later row
